name: Three Wise Monkeys
description: The classic see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil monkey trio representing willful ignorance or innocence.
meaning: Used to express wanting to stay out of drama, pretending not to notice something, or playing innocent.
examples: Whatever's happening in that group chat 🙈🙉🙊
seoDescription: What does 🙈🙉🙊 mean? The three wise monkeys emoji combo explained. Used to stay out of drama or play innocent.
